summary: Independent adversarial review found no blocker or important finding for the 32-run CHROMASS SDRF.

reviewer_context.context: Fresh isolated reviewer; inspected artifact, accession-scoped PRIDE/files records, publication, evidence manifest, specification, and deterministic outputs without producer transcript.

spec_compliance.evidence: Read TERMS.tsv, templates.yaml, ms-proteomics 1.1.0 and vertebrates 1.1.0 YAML. Xenopus laevis supports vertebrates; label-free DDA supports ms-proteomics. 32 rows have uniform 28-column width and no duplicate records; template declarations and repeated cleavage columns pass structure and parse_sdrf validation.

ontology_integrity.evidence: tools verify resolved and label-matched PRIDE:0000627, MS:1002877, MS:1001309, MS:1001251, and MS:1000422 in the declared ontology families. parse_sdrf validates Xenopus laevis and label free sample. Offline check found zero hallucinations, label mismatches, or wrong ontologies.

source_evidence.evidence: Accession-scoped pride.json accession PXD018217 and Gallina et al. PMC7864614 CHROMASS Methods support Xenopus egg extract plus sperm chromatin, untreated/2000 J/m2 UV-C, mock/REV1/RFWD3 depletion, quadruplicate reactions, two Normal/Fast technical injections, Q Exactive HF-X DDA HCD, label-free MS, and sequential Lys-C then trypsin digestion.

file_mapping.evidence: Every files.json record has projectAccessions exactly [PXD018217]. Its 32 RAW filenames equal the 32 unique SDRF data files with no missing or extra entries; two SEARCH and one FASTA deposit files are correctly excluded. Assay names match raw basenames.

design_consistency.evidence: Recomputed four condition groups with four biological preparations and two technical injections each: 16 sources, 32 assays. Group counts are eight each for C-C, C-UV, RF-UV, RV-UV. Untreated/mock occurs eight times; UV/mock, UV/RFWD3-depleted, UV/REV1-depleted occur eight times each. Factor values duplicate their corresponding characteristics per row.

omission_safety.evidence: Reviewed all distinct values across 28 columns against PRIDE protocol, publication, raw filenames, and template rules. Biological attributes without sample-level support remain not available. Optional/recommended mass tolerances and search modifications are omitted rather than inferred from MaxQuant defaults; no unsupported condition or instrument specificity was found.

deterministic_validation.evidence: parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -s annotations/PXD018217.sdrf.tsv -t ms-proteomics -t vertebrates --use_ols_cache_only exited 0. python -m tools structure exited 0; python -m tools check --offline exited 0 CLEAN; python -m tools score exited 0 with 87/100, its completeness note concerns omitted search parameters unsupported by deposited protocol.
